templates.description: Big centered title over a two-color gradient, sliding up and fading in, with a growing accent underline.
templates.name: Title card

text.description: The title text (one line, shrinks to fit the frame).

templates.prompt: Change text, bg1, bg2, fg and accent only. Keep the title to one short line — it shrinks to fit 90% of the width. The underline grows with the title; do not add a second line or a subtitle. Never invent numbers for the title: use only numbers the script actually gives.

templates.description: A ball bouncing on a floor line with squash on impact and a shadow that shrinks as the ball rises — pure gravity, no keyframes.
templates.name: Bouncing ball

apex.description: Ball apex height as a fraction of frame height (0.05 = near the top, 0.5 = low bounce). Raise it to clear a top text layer — diagnose warns when the ball reaches into the text band.

bounces.description: How many bounces in the shot.

radius.description: Ball radius as a fraction of the shorter frame side.

templates.prompt: Change bounces, apex, radius, color and bg only. The ball always bounces on the floor line at 0.62H and stays above the burned-caption band — do not move the floor. Raise apex to clear a top text layer; diagnose warns when the ball reaches into the text band. Each bounce takes duration/bounces seconds, so do not ask for more bounces than the shot length can show.

templates.description: A rounded card slides in from the left with a named easing curve, its text fading in after the card lands.
templates.name: Slide-in card

ease.description: Easing curve for the card slide-in (one of the fx.ease names; easeOutCubic is the old hard-coded curve).

templates.prompt: Change text, card, bg, fg and ease only. The card slides in from the left and the text fades in after the card lands — do not move the card's landing spot or retime the fade by hand. Keep the text short enough for one card.

templates.description: Concentric rings expand from the center and fade out, one after another — a calm pulse for intros and outros.
templates.name: Expanding rings

count.description: How many rings are in flight at once.

templates.prompt: Change color, count, speed and bg only. Keep it text-free — it is a calm pulse for intros, outros and breathing room, not a card for words. One ring takes 1/speed seconds to cross the frame.

templates.description: A rounded card springs in from nothing with a physical overshoot and settles — mass/stiffness/damping tune the bounce (a damped harmonic oscillator, not a fixed easing curve).
templates.name: Spring-in card

damping.description: Spring damping: lower = more overshoot and ringing, higher = calmer landing.

mass.description: Spring mass: heavier = slower, lazier settle.

stiffness.description: Spring stiffness: higher = snappier, faster settle.

templates.prompt: Change text, card, bg, fg, mass, stiffness and damping only. The card springs in from nothing with a physical overshoot — lower damping for more ringing, higher stiffness for a snappier settle. Do not retime the spring by hand; tune the three physics numbers instead.
